scope: External labeled electrical anomaly mechanism validation only; not streetlight field accuracy or fault probability.
prohibited_feature_families: rated load, lamp count, asset count, cabinet mapping

MAD.record_shape: 48 ordered time points per daily sample
MAD.normalization_provenance: Repository states each variable is normalized; phase comparison requires proof of common physical scale or documented common affine transform.

LG-S1.availability: At least 12 valid ordered values and positive calibration-derived robust scale.
LG-S1.interpretation: Within-record robust departure; meter-relative only with physical meter identity and prior history.

LG-S2.availability: LG-S1 available and sequence order intact.

LG-S3.availability: CONDITIONALLY_UNAVAILABLE for published normalized MAD tensors until phase identity, alignment, and common-scale provenance are confirmed.
LG-S3.interpretation: Phase-current magnitude asymmetry only; never negative/zero sequence, symmetrical components, or asset fault.

source_fields: LG-S1 robust residuals across ordered time
LG-S4.availability: Stable calibration reference and ordered sequence.

LG-S5.availability: At least two component scores; no imputation.
LG-S5.interpretation: Transparent multivariate electrical evidence with component values and availability flags.

lg_mappings.LG-S1: Available with ordered numeric load and calibration scale.
lg_mappings.LG-S5: Available with two or more actual non-phase components.

REFIT_ANNOTATED_LOAD.interpretation_ceiling: Real household load-anomaly mechanism only; no three-phase or streetlight inference.

lg_mappings.LG-S1: Available with ordered numeric values and calibration scale.
lg_mappings.LG-S5: Available with two or more actual components.

UCR_POWER_DEMAND.interpretation_ceiling: Generic benchmark stress test only; not external electrical mechanism or streetlight evidence.

global_contract.claim_boundary: External electrical anomaly mechanism validity is not streetlight field accuracy or fault probability.
